verdict.rationale: Server rendering is only implied. The docs position SvelteKit, Svelte's official app framework, as the counterpart to Next/Nuxt and describe static prerendering, and a community user notes clarity about what loads on the server vs client. Nothing in the pack explicitly documents request-time SSR, and there is no mention of streaming responses. Missing for 10: explicit documentation of request-time SSR, any evidence of streaming support (e.g., streamed promises or progressive HTML), hydration/time-to-interactive details, hands-on corroboration.
